feed.title: AwesomeCUA: newly reviewed resources
feed.subtitle: Computer-use agent papers, models, datasets, benchmarks and tools as they pass source review, newest review first. Metadata-only bibliography records and unreviewed candidates are not included.
feed.rights: Catalog annotations: MIT. Linked resources keep their own terms.

entry.title: Hermes Jev Skills
entry.summary: SKILL.md skills for Hermes, Claude Code and Codex agents that pass small decisions to the Jev model, including desktop and browser skills in which Jev picks each next action from a caller-built table.

entry.title: AI GameStore
entry.summary: A benchmark of 100 games adapted from App Store and Steam charts into web-playable versions, with a Playwright harness that sends game screenshots to vision-language models and executes their key presses.

entry.title: idevice
entry.summary: A Rust library that talks to iOS device services over lockdownd, usbmuxd and RSD, with features for screenshots, SpringBoard control, app installation and launching WebDriverAgent runners.

entry.title: MCP Link
entry.summary: A browser extension that lets chat AIs such as ChatGPT and Claude call user-approved MCP tools; with the companion MCP Link Server it adds automated browsing and web interactions.

entry.title: Operit2
entry.summary: A cross-device personal agent in preview that continues conversations and tasks across phones, desktops and cloud nodes, with file, terminal and browser tools that click, type and snapshot web pages.

entry.title: Scrapling
entry.summary: A Python scraping framework with HTTP and stealth browser fetchers and spiders, plus an MCP server whose seventeen tools let AI agents click, fill forms, type and take screenshots in browser sessions.

entry.title: Nakama
entry.summary: A team AI agent platform, run as managed cloud or one Docker container, whose agents can drive a per-user Kernel cloud browser or Chrome on the server to open pages, click and fill forms.

entry.title: OmniJev
entry.summary: OmniJev v1.1 is a 4B LoRA adapter with decision heads for Qwen3.5-4B that answers typed questions about screens and other images with probabilities; its task families include androidcontrol and web.

entry.title: Patchright .NET
entry.summary: Patchright .NET is the .NET package of Patchright: a patched Playwright that replaces the Microsoft.Playwright package and drives Chromium with automation leaks removed.

entry.title: Patchright NodeJS
entry.summary: Patchright NodeJS is the Node.js package of Patchright: a patched Playwright that drives Chromium through the standard JavaScript API with automation leaks removed.

entry.title: Patchright Python
entry.summary: Patchright Python is the Python package of Patchright: a patched Playwright that drives Chromium through the usual sync and async APIs with automation leaks removed.

entry.title: @mcp-b
entry.summary: TypeScript packages that connect pages registering tools through the WebMCP document.modelContext API to MCP, so agents in an extension, the browser or desktop clients can call them.

entry.title: AgentGym-RL-Data-ID
entry.summary: Train and eval task splits for AgentGym-RL multi-turn reinforcement learning, listing task IDs for WebArena web navigation alongside search, game, embodied and science environments.

entry.title: go-ios
entry.summary: A Go CLI and module that automates iOS devices from Linux, Windows or macOS: installing and launching apps, running XCTest and WebDriverAgent, taking screenshots and driving the UI.

entry.title: MCP-B
entry.summary: The earlier MCP-B codebase: a Chrome extension that discovers and calls tools websites expose as MCP servers, a Cloudflare Workers backend and a native server that relays those tools to desktop MCP clients.

entry.title: PTFakeTouch
entry.summary: An iOS framework that injects simulated touch events from inside an app, with calls for touch begin, move and end phases that produce taps at a point and swipes.

entry.title: WebMCP
entry.summary: An early WebMCP proposal and code: a script widget on a website registers its tools, resources and prompts, which MCP clients reach through a token-secured localhost WebSocket server.

entry.title: AXe
entry.summary: A command-line tool for iOS Simulator automation that reads the UI through accessibility APIs and sends HID taps, swipes and text input, with screenshot and video capture.

entry.title: SnapEye
entry.summary: A SnapDOM-based toolkit that lets coding agents capture, diff and record elements of a running web app through a CLI, an in-page API or URL triggers, with JSON results and exit codes.

entry.title: CUBE Standard
entry.summary: A Python protocol for wrapping agent benchmarks behind shared Tool, Task, Benchmark, Observation and Action types, with optional browser sessions, VM backends and browser and desktop computer tools.

entry.title: OmniJev-0.8B
entry.summary: OmniJev decision adapter for Qwen3.5-0.8B: LoRA weights and heads that return probabilities for typed questions about screens, video and robot scenes, evaluated on web and phone task families.

entry.title: OmniJev-2B
entry.summary: OmniJev decision adapter for Qwen3.5-2B: LoRA weights and heads that return probabilities for typed questions about screens, video and robot scenes, evaluated on web and phone task families.

entry.title: OmniJev-SFT-0.8B
entry.summary: Generative SFT baseline from the OmniJev release: a LoRA adapter over Qwen3.5-0.8B, trained for 12,500 steps, that answers image questions with text; the card reports scores on AndroidControl, web and phone families.

entry.title: UI-Mate-27B
entry.summary: A 27B GUI agent model from the UI-Mate release, trained from Qwen3.6-27B with supervised fine-tuning and online reinforcement learning to turn instructions and screenshots into keyboard and mouse actions.

entry.title: UI-Mate-9B
entry.summary: A 9B GUI agent model from the UI-Mate release, trained from Qwen3.5-9B with supervised fine-tuning and online reinforcement learning to turn instructions and screenshots into keyboard and mouse actions.

entry.title: UI-Mate-democua-27B
entry.summary: A 27B checkpoint of the UI-Mate desktop agent, fine-tuned from Qwen3.6-27B, that reads screenshots and can follow one recorded demonstration to plan keyboard and mouse actions on a new task.

entry.title: Argent
entry.summary: Argent is a CLI toolkit that lets an AI assistant tap, swipe and type in iOS simulators, Android emulators and devices, TVs and Electron apps, and also records end-to-end test paths, diffs screens and profiles apps.

entry.title: Chrome Launcher
entry.summary: Chrome Launcher is a Node.js module that finds and starts Chrome with a fresh profile, an open remote-debugging port and flags that quiet services for automated runs.

entry.title: chrome-aws-lambda
entry.summary: chrome-aws-lambda bundles Chromium for running Puppeteer or Playwright inside AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Functions, with launch flags and page helpers for clicking, form filling and waiting.

entry.title: Cognitive Kernel
entry.summary: Cognitive Kernel is a dockerized agent system whose fine-tuned policy model drives a Playwright browser by clicking, typing and scrolling, alongside file handling and long-term memory.

entry.title: CognitiveKernel-Pro-Query
entry.summary: CognitiveKernel-Pro-Query holds the training queries generated for Cognitive Kernel-Pro: multi-hop URLQA and hint-annotated AgentWebQA in JSONL, used to sample web agent trajectories.

entry.title: CognitiveKernel-Pro-SFT
entry.summary: CognitiveKernel-Pro-SFT contains rejection-sampled GPT-4.1 trajectories for fine-tuning Cognitive Kernel-Pro agents, from URLQA web queries, DocBench, TableBench and a WebWalkerQA subset.

entry.title: Qwen3-8B-CK-Pro
entry.summary: Qwen3-8B-CK-Pro is the CK-Pro-8B agent foundation model from Cognitive Kernel-Pro, fine-tuned from Qwen3-8B on self-collected trajectories; the card reports 32.7% Pass@1 on the GAIA dev set.

entry.title: serial-hid-kvm
entry.summary: serial-hid-kvm drives a target PC’s keyboard and mouse through a CH9329 USB HID emulator and captures its screen over HDMI, with a preview window, web viewer and JSON Lines TCP API.

entry.title: WebAggregator
entry.summary: WebAggregator is the code for Explore to Evolve: it builds verifiable web QA data by agent exploration of URLs, samples trajectories with a smolagents agent that clicks and types in a browser, and runs evaluation.

entry.title: Cuprite
entry.summary: Ruby driver that runs Capybara tests in headless Chrome or Chromium through Ferrum over the DevTools Protocol, with device emulation, URL filtering and mouse control.

entry.title: iosef
entry.summary: Swift CLI and MCP server that lets agents drive the iOS Simulator: read the accessibility tree, tap by selector or coordinates, swipe, pinch, type and take screenshots.

entry.title: libuiohook
entry.summary: C library that installs global keyboard and mouse hooks from userland on Windows, macOS and Linux and can post synthetic input events, with hook and event-post demos.

entry.title: MobileBuildMCP
entry.summary: MCP server and CLI that lets coding agents build, run and debug iOS and macOS apps, and drive iOS simulators with taps, swipes, typing, UI snapshots and screenshots.

entry.title: Puppeteer Real Browser
entry.summary: Node.js package that launches Chrome and connects Puppeteer for browsing with fewer automation signals, with Turnstile clicking and cursor-driven clicks. Its maintainers have ended updates.

entry.title: Scrapeless SDK Go
entry.summary: Go client for the Scrapeless platform that creates remote browser sessions with anti-detection options, manages profiles and extensions, and calls crawl and scraping APIs.

entry.title: Brotector
entry.summary: JavaScript test page that detects webdriver automation from Selenium, Puppeteer, Playwright, nodriver and related tools through leaks such as navigator.webdriver, Runtime.enable and untrusted input events.

entry.title: Harden Vanilla Puppeteer
entry.summary: Patch-package diffs that edit core Puppeteer files to run page calls in an isolated world and strip Puppeteer strings from error traces and profile names, lowering automation detection.

entry.title: NotebookLM MCP Server
entry.summary: MCP server that operates Google NotebookLM in a real Chrome through Patchright, letting coding agents ask notebook questions, add sources, generate audio overviews and read citations.

entry.title: predicate-authorityd
entry.summary: Rust sidecar that checks each agent action, such as a browser click on a URL, against local ALLOW/DENY policy rules and issues short-lived mandates, with a terminal dashboard and a web UI.

entry.title: rebrowser-bot-detector
entry.summary: Browser test page whose checks flag automation leaks from Puppeteer and Playwright, such as Runtime.enable use, injected source URLs, main-world execution and headless signals, each with a suggested fix.

entry.title: stagehand-plasmate
entry.summary: TypeScript wrapper that gives Stagehand pages Plasmate's Semantic Object Model JSON in place of raw DOM, with SOM queries by role, text or ID, while act() and observe() go to Stagehand.

entry.title: adbutils
entry.summary: A Python client for the ADB server that lists and connects devices, runs shell commands, forwards ports, transfers files, takes screenshots and sends taps, swipes and key events.

entry.title: android-uiautomator-server
entry.summary: An Android instrumentation app that runs a JSON-RPC server for UIAutomator on the device so PC-side scripts can write UI tests; its README points to a successor repository.

entry.title: android-uiautomator-server-jar
entry.summary: An on-device JSON-RPC server for Android UIAutomator, launched through app_process, that lets PC-side scripts click, dump the window hierarchy and type text through a bundled keyboard.

entry.title: Kea2
entry.summary: A Python tool for fuzzing Android apps that joins Fastbot's automated UI exploration with human-written scripts and property-based assertions to find crashes and functional bugs.

entry.title: Maxim
entry.summary: An Android Monkey stress tester for emulators and real devices that parses on-screen controls through the accessibility service and explores apps with random, DFS or priority-guided strategies.

entry.title: PlayJev-0.8B
entry.summary: A 0.8B checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base that picks a move in ten browser games from one rendered frame and an option list, trained by behaviour cloning and three DAgger rounds.

entry.title: u2_webview
entry.summary: A uiautomator2 extension that attaches to WebView pages in Android hybrid apps over CDP through DrissionPage, so one Python script can drive both the native UI and the H5 layer.

entry.title: uiautodev
entry.summary: A mobile device control and UI automation tool for Android, iOS and HarmonyOS with a desktop app and a server; this repository holds the npm CLI that downloads and runs the server binary.

entry.title: GUI_Reflection_8b_pretrain
entry.summary: GUI Reflection checkpoint from the GUI pre-training stage, trained on grounding, captioning, OCR and VQA data plus reflection-task data, before the offline SFT stage.

entry.title: GUI_Reflection_8b_SFT
entry.summary: Final GUI Reflection agent checkpoint, built on InternVL, that predicts mobile GUI actions from a screenshot and task goal after training on reflection and error-correction data.

entry.title: GUI_Reflection_Task_Suite_Benchmark
entry.summary: Evaluation split of the GUI Reflection Task Suite, with JSONL files for action verification, action reversal and mistake-informed reattempts on ScreenSpot and ScreenSpot v2.

entry.title: GUI_Reflection_Task_Suite_train
entry.summary: Training split of the GUI Reflection Task Suite: JSONL files for action verification, action reversal and mistake-informed reattempt, built on AndroidControl, GUI Odyssey, AMEX, OS-Atlas and Wave UI.

entry.title: Online Environment for GUI Reflection
entry.summary: Host-worker Android emulator environment from the GUI Reflection project, with configs that collect interaction data and evaluate GUI models while inference runs on a separate host machine.

entry.title: PhoneHarness Bench
entry.summary: Task definitions and verifier metadata for 124 mixed-action Android phone tasks and 30 safety tasks, where agents may act through app GUIs, device commands and MCP-style tools.

entry.title: Plasmate Skill for OpenClaw
entry.summary: OpenClaw skill with an Agent Web Protocol client that drives a local Plasmate server to navigate pages, click and type by element reference, and extract structured data.

entry.title: Playwright CRX
entry.summary: Chrome extension edition of Playwright that drives open browser tabs through chrome.debugger, usable as a library and as an extension that records and replays scripts with tracing.

entry.title: LocateAnything-3B
entry.summary: LocateAnything-3B is a 3B vision-language grounding model that predicts full bounding boxes in parallel, covering GUI element grounding alongside object detection, documents and OCR.

entry.title: Orchard-Agentic
entry.summary: Orchard-Agentic holds the Orchard environment service, an RL training stack and evaluation code, with recipes for software, browser-navigation and CLI agents and an index of follow-on projects.

entry.title: WildAWM-35B-A3B
entry.summary: WildAWM-35B-A3B is a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B agent checkpoint post-trained on WildAWM cross-interface computer tasks that mix web, MCP and CLI actions, served text-only with SGLang.

entry.title: WildAWM-4B
entry.summary: WildAWM-4B is a Qwen3.5-4B agent checkpoint post-trained on WildAWM cross-interface computer tasks that mix web, MCP and CLI actions, served text-only with SGLang.

entry.title: pix2struct-large
entry.summary: Pretrained large Pix2Struct weights, an image-to-text model pretrained to parse masked web page screenshots into simplified HTML, intended for fine-tuning on visual language tasks.

entry.title: Playwright for Python
entry.summary: Python package of Playwright that drives Chromium, Firefox and WebKit through one API, with synchronous and asynchronous interfaces for page navigation and screenshots.

entry.title: cmux-skills
entry.summary: Agent Skills for the cmux macOS terminal that teach coding agents its CLI, workspaces and panes, and how to drive its embedded browser with snapshots, element refs, clicks, waits and screenshots.

entry.title: ExACT-VWA
entry.summary: Post-processed R-MCTS and GPT-4o agent trajectories collected on VisualWebArena, stored as context and response pairs with domain and task metadata; part of the set was used to fine-tune GPT-4o.

entry.title: MaaEvidenceKit
entry.summary: A CLI and TypeScript SDK that extracts located runtime and static evidence from MaaFramework logs and projects, with stable evidence IDs, timelines and JSON or text views for agent harnesses.

entry.title: WebGenAgent-LM-7B-SFT
entry.summary: The 7B supervised fine-tuned checkpoint of WebGen-Agent, which writes website code from instructions and refines it with screenshot critiques and GUI-agent functional tests.

entry.title: WebGenAgent-LM-7B-Step-GRPO
entry.summary: The 7B Step-GRPO checkpoint of WebGen-Agent, which writes website code from instructions; training used screenshot scores and GUI-agent test scores as step-level rewards.

entry.title: WebGenAgent-LM-8B-SFT
entry.summary: The 8B supervised fine-tuned checkpoint of WebGen-Agent, which writes website code from instructions and refines it with screenshot critiques and GUI-agent functional tests.

entry.title: WebGenAgent-LM-8B-Step-GRPO
entry.summary: The 8B Step-GRPO checkpoint of WebGen-Agent, which writes website code from instructions; training used screenshot scores and GUI-agent test scores as step-level rewards.

entry.title: WebHarbor
entry.summary: Docker-based local mirrors of 153 real websites with auth and databases, plus 3,518 tasks with verifiers for evaluating and RL-training GUI web agents, and a control plane for sub-second site resets.

entry.title: Everything Maa
entry.summary: A set of 13 AI skills and MCP profiles for Claude Code and Codex that build, edit, test and diagnose MaaFramework automation projects and run device and Pipeline operations through maafw-cli.

entry.title: Maa Support Extension
entry.summary: A VS Code extension for MaaFramework projects that queries, completes and checks Pipeline tasks and image paths, runs interface.json tasks, takes screenshots and opens Pipelines in MaaPipelineEditor.

entry.title: MaaDebugger
entry.summary: A debugger for MaaFramework automation projects that runs as a local web interface on port 8011 by default, installed from PyPI with pip or uv; a Go and web rewrite is published on npm.

entry.title: MaaLogAnalyzer
entry.summary: A visual analyzer for MaaFramework application logs that shows task execution with recognition and action details, keyword and regex search, an ELK node flowchart with replay, and run statistics.

entry.title: MaaPipelineEditor
entry.summary: A browser-based visual editor for MaaFramework Pipeline JSON that builds automation flows as connected nodes, with OCR and screenshot helpers, node templates, flow debugging and an optional local service.

entry.title: MaaTouch
entry.summary: An Android-native implementation of the minitouch input protocol that accepts line commands for touch down, move and up, waits, key events and text entry to drive a device.

entry.title: MXU
entry.summary: A Tauri, React and TypeScript GUI client that loads any MaaFramework PI V2 interface.json and runs its tasks, with drag-ordered task lists, multiple instances, live device screenshots, logs and scheduled runs.

entry.title: ok-script
entry.summary: A Python framework for screen automation of Windows apps, games and Android devices with template matching, OCR and input, plus an MCP server through which coding agents screenshot targets, run, reload and package tasks.

entry.title: MaaCtl
entry.summary: A command-line client for MaaFramework that loads ProjectInterface v2 projects, inspects their controllers, resources and tasks, and runs tasks or pipeline nodes on ADB devices or desktop windows.

entry.title: maafw-cli
entry.summary: A command-line interface to MaaFramework that lets people, scripts and coding agents connect to ADB or Win32 targets, run OCR and template matching, and click recognized elements by reference.

entry.title: MaaInspector
entry.summary: A Tauri desktop node editor for MaaFramework 5 pipelines that builds workflows by drag and drop and runs and debugs nodes while showing their execution state.

entry.title: MaaOWM
entry.summary: A Python workspace manager for MaaFramework projects with several adaptation packs: mounting merges base and mod pipelines into an editable workspace, and unmounting diffs it back to a minimal mod.

entry.title: MFAAvalonia
entry.summary: A cross-platform Avalonia desktop GUI for MaaFramework resource projects that reads Project Interface V2 definitions and lets users configure, schedule and run automation tasks.

entry.title: MFW-ChainFlow Assistant
entry.summary: A PySide6 desktop runner for MaaFramework projects that implements the interface v2 protocol, with configuration management, scheduled runs, notifications and custom actions.

entry.title: MWU
entry.summary: A general browser-based interface for MaaFramework resource projects, built with Vue 3 and FastAPI, with two agent run modes, system notifications and automatic updates.

entry.title: XDeviceBridge
entry.summary: A C library, server and xdb CLI for iPhone and iPad discovery, pairing, screenshots, video capture and touch, keyboard and text input over USB or Wi-Fi.

entry.title: agentboard
entry.summary: Evaluation data of the AgentBoard benchmark for multi-turn LLM agents: 9 tasks in embodied, game, web and tool settings, including WebShop and WebArena, with goals, subgoals and difficulty labels.

entry.title: Cowork Protocol
entry.summary: A WebMCP collaboration protocol for people and web agents: agents read bounded field focus packets, propose visible changes that a human click applies, and act alone only inside scoped leases.

entry.title: GUI Agent Research Landscape
entry.summary: A research-landscape analysis of GUI and OS agent papers from 2016 to 2025: citation mining, keyword filtering to about 600 papers, LLM-extracted contributions, period trend tables and citation-network rankings.

entry.title: GUI-Actor-for-FiftyOne
entry.summary: Training code that fine-tunes the GUI-Actor grounding model on FiftyOne datasets, turning keypoint and box annotations on screenshots into conversations with pointer supervision for single-GPU runs.

entry.title: invisible_puppeteer
entry.summary: A Python package with pyppeteer's Puppeteer API that drives an anti-detect Firefox, setting the browser fingerprint inside the engine and moving the mouse along humanized paths.

entry.title: invisible_selenium
entry.summary: A Python package with Selenium's webdriver API that drives an anti-detect Firefox without geckodriver, setting the browser fingerprint inside the engine and moving the mouse along humanized paths.

entry.title: JUMPDiscovery
entry.summary: Task data for the Orion computer-using agent's open discovery task: a problem statement, CellProfiler pipelines, gene sets and a script that downloads JUMP Cell Painting morphological profiles.
